_doc: Per-page data and slot requirements for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 declares all ten planned pages (one per major spec); requires_layers / requires_slots / preloads are stubbed empty because none of the pages has a renderer yet — they're scaffold specs. Each pageN's _doc captures what the page will read once its phase ships.
_round1_status: Ten pages declared as scaffolds (post-2026-05-19 meiosis migration). Real requires_* are added per page as renderers wire in (phase B+). The former page11/page12 entries moved to meiosis-atlas (see _migration_note below).

page1._doc: Static landing page. Six sections: vision, required data layers (eight chips, all '⚪ not loaded' in round 1), chromosome-overview mockup (gradient stand-ins for real density tracks), planned-panel inventory, phasing roadmap (A → E), cross-references to the three sibling atlases. SCHEMA §28. Round-1 status: stub-preserving + lifecycle scaffolding — mount() builds a no-op _pageState; unmount() clears it. Renderer hook (refreshPage1) is a no-op pending phase B+.

page2._doc: Headline assembly QC: BUSCO single-copy %, contig/scaffold N50, gap rate, T2T completeness, total length. Six global tiles + a per-chromosome QC table (chrom × haplotype, with centromere/telomere status, T2T chip). Phase B wires assembly_stats + centromere_telomere layers. Future requires_layers: ['assembly_stats', 'centromere_telomere'].

page3._doc: Primary phase-B deliverable. One row per chromosome, length-scaled across the page. Stacked sub-tracks: base bar (with centromere overlay), gene density, repeat density, conserved-element density, CO density (sex-collapsed, from crossover_track which lives in meiosis-atlas post-2026-05-19 — cross-atlas read; clicking pivots to meiosis-atlas/crossovers_per_candidate for the active candidate), cohort overlay (L2 envelopes + candidates from the Inversion Atlas). Mirrors scrubber width so the two atlases can be stacked. Future requires_layers: ['chromosome_map', 'gene_track', 'repeat_track', 'conserved_elements', 'centromere_telomere'] (locally-owned) + ['crossover_track'] (cross-atlas, owned by meiosis-atlas). Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidate'] (cross-atlas reads).

page4._doc: Pure documentation page describing the HiFi + Hi-C + ONT haplotype-resolved assembly pipeline. Five stages from raw reads to curated FAI+AGP. No data layers, no renderer. Ships round 1 in its final shape; no phase B/C upgrade planned beyond text edits.

page5._doc: Three views: (1) genome-wide gene-density bar chart, one bar per chrom; (2) per-chrom gene track (boxes + introns) on a length-scaled axis driven by activeChrom; (3) gene cargo per inversion candidate — for every promoted candidate, list genes inside the span, sorted by SnpEff impact when variant_annotations is loaded. Bridges the assembly paper to the Inversion Atlas. Future requires_layers: ['gene_track', 'chromosome_map', 'variant_annotations']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidateList'].

page6._label: repeats / TE — landscape and breakpoint enrichment
page6._doc: Three views: per-class composition (LTR / LINE / SINE / DNA / simple / unclassified), per-chrom density heatmap, breakpoint enrichment per inversion candidate using the Spalax-style focal-vs-bg widget (same widget the Inversion Atlas uses on page16). Future requires_layers: ['repeat_track', 'chromosome_map']. Future requires_slots: ['candidateList'].

page7._doc: Phase E (final piece of the Genome Atlas). SnpEff / VEP impact category overlay per inversion candidate. Three views: per-candidate impact tally table, compact impact bar (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/MODIFIER), expandable HIGH-impact variant list. Depends on MODULE_CONSERVATION cluster-side deliverables (VESM / SIFT4G / SnpEff / GERP++). Future requires_layers: ['variant_annotations', 'gene_track']. Future requires_slots: ['candidateList'].

page8._doc: Phase C–D. UCE + phastCons regulatory-disruption overlay per inversion candidate. Three views: per-chrom element tick strip, per-candidate UCE overlap table, continuous phastCons score profile. Complements page5 (gene cargo) by counting regulatory hits. Future requires_layers: ['conserved_elements', 'synteny_blocks']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidateList'].

page9._doc: Phase D. Cross-species collinearity for Cgar vs related Siluriformes (Cmac, I. punctatus, plus 7-9 more via catfish-synteny-toolkit wfmash). Three views: pairwise ribbon (one species pair), multi-species ribbon stack, per-chrom dotplot. Inversions render as anti-parallel polygons; translocations as chrom-jumping polygons. Ties to Inversion Atlas page16 cross-species breakpoint catalogue. Future requires_layers: ['synteny_blocks', 'chromosome_map']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom'].

page10._doc: Phase D. Ancestral karyotype panel + phylogeny-with-events + per-element descent map. Same Cactus output as page9, viewed phylogenetically rather than pairwise. Likely promoted to a Supplementary Note in the assembly paper. Future requires_layers: ['synteny_blocks', 'chromosome_map'].

pages._migration_note_2026_05_19: page11 (crossovers) and page12 (NCO / gene conversion) moved to meiosis-atlas as `crossovers_per_candidate` and `nco_per_candidate` (both under the meiosis hub stage). Per-candidate meiosis views belong in the Meiosis Atlas; the Genome Atlas page3 CO-density sub-track now reads the meiosis-owned crossover_track layer cross-atlas.
